articles.title: Syrian Political Decision-Making: Between Power, Constraint, and Pragmatism
articles.excerpt: At present, Syrian political decision-making operates under a policy of shock absorption and damage mitigation, Firas Allawi writes in al-Thawra. The post Syrian Political Decision-Making: Between Power, Constraint, and Pragmatism first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 叙利亚评论员菲拉斯·阿拉维在《革命报》撰文指出，当前叙利亚政治决策在权力制约与务实考量之间运作，采取「吸收冲击、减轻损害」的政策取向。

articles.title: Testimonies Reveal Abuse of Syrian Detainees in Israeli Prisons After Ground Incursions
articles.excerpt: The disciplinary system governed even the smallest details of daily life, with minor infractions routinely triggering violence. The post Testimonies Reveal Abuse of Syrian Detainees in Israeli Prisons After Ground Incursions first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 相关证词披露，以色列地面入侵后，被关押在以色列监狱的叙利亚被拘留者遭到虐待；其纪律制度管控日常生活细节，轻微违规常引发暴力。

articles.title: European Maps Show Rising Soil Moisture Across Syria, Heightening Flash Flood Concerns
articles.excerpt: The ministry stated that mapping based on data from 1 November 2026 revealed varying moisture levels across Syrian regions. The post European Maps Show Rising Soil Moisture Across Syria, Heightening Flash Flood Concerns first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 叙方部门表示，基于2026年11月1日数据的测绘显示叙利亚各地土壤湿度水平不一；欧洲测绘地图显示叙全境土壤湿度上升，加剧山洪风险担忧。
